_comment: This file is a declarative configuration file (dict/variable assignments only) for mmpretrain BEiT pretraining on ImageNet. It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — it defines model architecture, data pipeline, optimizer, and runtime settings as configuration variables consumed by the mmengine/mmpretrain framework.
review_BEiT_config: review the BEiT pretraining config for model backbone, head, and target generator settings
review_train_pipeline: review the ImageNet training pipeline with ColorJitter, RandomFlip, and BEiTMaskGenerator
review_optim_wrapper: review the AMP optimizer wrapper with AdamW, gradient clipping, and paramwise weight decay
review_param_scheduler: review the learning rate scheduler with LinearLR warmup and CosineAnnealingLR over 300 epochs
review_data_preprocessor: review the TwoNormDataPreprocessor config with dual normalization for BEiT masked image modeling
